d: Football witnessed another ugly reminder of its hooliganism problem as violence erupted around two separate UEFA Europa League matches. In Georgia, the Beşiktaş vs Hapoel Be’er Sheva fixture was interrupted after clashes involving police and supporters. In France, Ligue 1 giants Marseille fans breached the away section during the match against Levski Sofia, leaving Bulgarian supporters injured. Rupha Ramani looks at the two disturbing episodes and the growing concern over safety inside and around football stadiums.
